activity_b.text: Good morning. I’m doing my safety inspection in the electrical engineering workshop.
I noticed the first-aid kit is almost empty.
Before I write a report, can you explain what happened this week?
I saw several items missing.
Good morning, sir. Yes, there were a few minor incidents.
On Monday, Ravi got a small cut on his finger while stripping the insulation of an old cable.
We used the last pack of sterile wipes.
Then yesterday, Farah got a mild burn on her hand after touching a soldering tip that was still hot.
So the burn gel finished.
And the tweezers and eye drops?
They should be in the kit at all times.
Those were used on Tuesday.
Thilak had a splinter in his finger from a cracked wooden cable reel.
We removed it, but the tweezers slipped and broke.
The eye drops finished because Mala got dust in her eye while cleaning the fuse board.
There was too much carbon dust inside.
I also noticed there are no compression bandages or cold packs left.
What happened?
Yesterday afternoon, Ameen had a bruise on his arm when he bumped into the metal casing of the generator.
This morning, Faiz complained about a stiff neck and sore shoulder after lifting heavy coil packs without warming up.
Later, Meena had a sore knee from kneeling on the workshop floor while wiring a control panel.
And the gloves?
They were listed in last month’s inventory.
They finished last week.
Everyone has dry hands from constant cleaning with degreaser and contact cleaner.
And the blocked nose case?
That was Suresh.
He inhaled too much dust near the circuit-breaker repair area.
You must restock everything before tomorrow.
I will check again in the afternoon.
Yes, sir. We’re going to order wipes, tweezers, burn gel, bandages, cold packs, and gloves today.
